purpose: Product detail page that hosts the add-to-cart form (form id pd-form, quantity field addtocart_{productId}.EnteredQuantity).

success.bodySignal: HTML title 'Shop. TRANSOCEAN CHRONOGRAPH'; Add to cart link is JS-driven (href '#')

purpose: Add a product to the cart (cartType 1) via XHR form post; repeat adds of the same product accumulate quantity on one cart line.

bodyFields.name: addtocart_{productId}.EnteredQuantity
bodyFields.description: Quantity to add. Missing field adds 1. 0, negative or non-numeric gives success:false 'Quantity should be positive'.

pathParams.name: productId
pathParams.description: Numeric product id (1 = TRANSOCEAN CHRONOGRAPH). Unknown numeric id gives 200 + redirect JSON; 0 or non-numeric gives 404.

pathParams.name: cartType
pathParams.description: 1 = shopping cart (observed from the UI). Value 99 returned success:true but did not change the cart count; other values not explored.

failure.bodySignal: Invalid quantity: {"success":false,"message":["Quantity should be positive"]}. Unknown productId 999999: {"redirect":"/"}. productId 0 or abc: HTTP 404 HTML. GET method: 404. Bodyless POST must still send Content-Length (curl -d '') or IIS returns 411.

purpose: Return the mini-cart (offcanvas) HTML fragment with the current cart lines, quantities and subtotal.

success.bodySignal: text/html fragment div.offcanvas-cart-body with item rows (input name item.EnteredQuantity, data-sci-id = cart line id, data-update-url /shoppingcart/updatecartitem), subtotal, links to /cart and checkout. In the browser, right after an add it also contained an alert 'The product <name> has been successfully added to your cart'; the curl replay did not show that alert.

failure.bodySignal: POST without Content-Length: IIS 'HTTP Error 411'. GET also returns 200 with the same fragment.

purpose: Return the header counters (cart, wishlist, compare item counts) as JSON; the UI calls it after each add and on every page load.

query.name: cart
query.description: Include CartItemsCount (the UI sends cart=True after an add).

query.name: wishlist
query.description: Include wishlist counter (page load sends cart=True&wishlist=True&compare=True).

success.bodySignal: JSON {"CartItemsCount":n,"WishlistItemsCount":n,"CompareItemsCount":n}. CartItemsCount is the sum of quantities, not the number of lines.

failure.bodySignal: GET returns 404 HTML; POST without Content-Length returns 411.
